scientific_limits.en: {"representation":"living-reconstruction","scope":"Whole adult animal: robust early sauropodomorph hindquarters and relatively shortened forequarters. Not hatchling, partial skeleton or a recoloured Massospondylus.","scientific_limits":{"en":"Original living reconstruction based on a published adult composite, not a complete single skeleton. Adult skull is missing; Otero2019 used a scaled Plateosaurus skull and restored missing tail parts with Plateosaurus. Our conservative head and tail are likewise inferred, not direct Mussaurus adult cranial evidence. Scale and soft tissue are approximate.","zh":"依据已发表成年合成骨架制作完整活体美术复原，并非完整单一标本。成年头骨未保存，2019研究借用等比例板龙头骨并补配尾部；本作头尾缺失部分同样属于推断，不称作鼠龙成年头骨实证。尺度和软组织为估计。"},"inventory_ordinal":345,"name":{"en":"Mussaurus","zh":"鼠龙"},"taxon":"Mussaurus patagonicus","classification":"Dinosauria, Saurischia, Sauropodomorpha","scale":{"total_length_m":5.5,"basis":"Approximate display length estimated from Figure1d adult reconstruction and its100cm bar; not a fossil total-length measurement. Published adult femur0.726m supplies independent proportion anchor."},"diagnostic_targets":["Deep robust ribcage and substantial pelvis/upper thighs, not the slender neck-dominated Massospondylus body.","Short free forelimbs contrasted with robust longer hindlimbs in adult bipedal stance; no hatchling quadrupedal proportions.","Substantial muscular tail base with long tapering tail; tail bulk integral to adult silhouette.","Moderately long neck and small conservative head, no invented cranial crest or oversized embryo skull.","Grasping hands facing inward, not load-bearing columnar sauropod forefeet."],"specimen_basis":"Otero etal2019 Figure1d actual adult fossil elements and gray-preserved-bone reconstruction personally inspected.
